description: Trigger discrimination for exploratory charter design: a timeboxed scoped session versus scripted manual cases (manual-test-case-creator), live walkthrough execution (clickthrough-test-engineer, manual-only), the deterministic per-change plan (test-plan-designer), and the product-wide QA strategy (qa-strategy-architect).

cases.prompt: We keep finding checkout edge cases by accident. Design a timeboxed exploratory session to hunt for more deliberately.
cases.reason: A timeboxed, risk-driven exploratory session is a charter; no per-change layer plan or product-wide strategy decision is in view.

cases.prompt: Write step-by-step manual test cases for password reset with exact data and expected results.
cases.reason: Stranger-executable scripted cases are manual-test-case-creator's output; a charter has no scripted steps or expected results.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke clickthrough-test-engineer. Walk through the running app's checkout flow and report the defects you find.
cases.reason: Executing a live walkthrough and reporting defects is clickthrough-test-engineer (manual-only); this skill designs the session and runs nothing.

cases.prompt: Plan the testing for the upcoming release — layers, data, entry and exit criteria.
cases.reason: A deterministic per-change plan with layers and exit criteria is test-plan-designer; a charter is a manual exploration contract, not a test plan.

cases.prompt: Decide our long-term QA investment — what to automate, what stays manual, and who owns each layer.
cases.reason: Product-wide automation/manual investment is the QA strategy; a charter scopes one exploratory session inside it.

cases.prompt: QA keeps saying we need to explore the dashboard rewrite. Turn that into a scoped session plan.
cases.reason: Turning an unguided 'explore X' into a timeboxed, scoped charter is this skill's core; no scripted cases or deterministic plan are requested.
